Third-party code used for in-browser barcode scanning (only loaded on browsers without a native BarcodeDetector):

barcode-detector 3.x  (MIT)  https://github.com/Sec-ant/barcode-detector   - vendor/barcode-detector.js
zxing-wasm 3.1.3      (MIT)  https://github.com/Sec-ant/zxing-wasm          - vendor/zxing_reader.wasm
zxing-cpp             (Apache-2.0) https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp    - compiled into the wasm file
